title: A stack batch keeps its shape after the Foreman's compactions
summary: Spec v4: asks refuses a per-CR ready-to-merge in a stack batch while another chain CR has an open PR or a stacked CR is open, naming the shape line's next; CRs outside the chain ask alone; --outside-stack needs an open order on the CR; shape line; foreman-stack.md; CoS sends mismatched asks back.
